meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会检查本机 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装状态,与最新源码对比,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上对应命令输出或文件作为证据,只诊断不改动你的安装。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词,或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex 健康检查,看安装有没有问题
say.note: 输出逐条附证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: Codex 更新后行为不对劲,帮我诊断一下
say.note: 会把本机安装和最新源码做漂移对比

say.text: 检查我的 Codex 版本能不能支持 gpt-6-astra
say.note: 核对 0.153.1 版本门槛和模型缓存文件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it to the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where each verdict cites its evidence. It only diagnoses; it won't change your setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or omo-codex, or when Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex health check on my install
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with cited evidence.

say_en.text: Codex behaves oddly after an update - diagnose it
say_en.note: Compares your install against the latest sources.

say_en.text: Check if my Codex version supports gpt-6-astra
